# Cosimo by Medici & Company

> AI for recurring financial operations: reports, checks, follow-ups, and review packs for banks, funds, insurance teams, and financial services firms.

## Product

Cosimo is the product. Medici & Company is the company. Workflows are configured and tested with the team around its sources, reporting format, and review process. The team checks the draft, resolves open questions, and approves the final version.

## Website pages

- [Overview](/): Financial operations software for banks, funds, insurance teams, and financial services firms.
- [Banks](/banks/): Loan activity reviews, borrower packs, account-file checks, and review preparation.
- [Funds](/funds/): Reporting, portfolio updates, and investor requests; an interactive quarterly portfolio-update example.
- [Insurance](/insurance/): Renewal preparation, submission checks, claims-file summaries, and document follow-ups.
- [Financial Services](/services/): Client reporting, document collection, and review packs for administration, accounting, and advisory firms.
- [Real estate](/re/): LP reports, investor statements, capital call notices, and distribution notices.
- [Venture capital](/vc/): Founder updates, portfolio metrics, cash and runway, and LP reporting.
- [Private equity](/pe/): Company actuals and budgets, variance commentary, portfolio packs, and LP reporting.
- [Private credit](/credit/): Borrower review packs, covenant worksheets, reporting follow-ups, and LP updates.
- [Hedge funds](/hedge/): Investor letters, close exceptions, investor activity, and allocator response drafts.
- [FAQ](/faq.html): What the product does, how the examples work, and how to start.
- [About](/about.html): Product and company information.
- [The founders](/founders.html): Eliot leads product, Shariq engineering, and Aamina clients.
- [Extended description](/llms-full.txt): More detail on the proposed workflows and examples.

## Examples and claim boundaries

The website examples use fictional records and prewritten outputs, not live product runs or customer results. Source links open sample records. The examples do not establish measured time savings, integration coverage, audit readiness, security certification, or guaranteed turnaround. Workflow-specific configuration and testing are required. The team retains review and approval.

## Start with one process

Email info@medici.ai with what your team prepares, where the information comes from, and which part takes the most time. Medici & Company works through a first workflow to test with the team. Scope and commercial terms are agreed before starting; evaluation starts with one task and one period of source files under NDA, written feasibility confirmation, and a review of the run and its sources. Model usage is charged at cost without markup; platform terms are agreed in conversation.

Website: https://cosimo.work

## Tested product work

The October 2026 product deck documents daily production use by live clients, nine of ten RE processes tested figure by figure on synthetic demonstration funds, and 83 calculation scripts with 1,822 passing tests. A quarterly report run for five properties and eight investors matched figures to the cent against an 88-row source sheet and raised five exceptions. These are specific validation results, separate from the illustrative website walkthroughs, not universal accuracy or timing guarantees. Approval rules are configurable per process and user; the product can send authorized communications.
